result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: a misspelled search placeholder, scroll content clipped behind the bottom tab bar, and carousel items truncated at the right edge.

issues.description: Search bar placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' - 'Restaurants' is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: Bottom scroll content has no padding above the tab bar - the second 'Popular right now' pizza card image touches the bottom navigation and its name, rating and delivery info are hidden underneath/behind it.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset / safe-area padding to the scroll view so the last card scrolls fully above the sticky bottom tab bar.

issues.description: Horizontal lists are clipped at the right screen edge - the category filter row shows a cut-off pill and the 'Fastest near you' third restaurant name is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' without ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal end-padding to carousels and use proper text truncation with ellipsis so items are not hard-clipped mid-character.
